map.位移公式（x = v₀·t + ½·a·t²）: Displacement formula (x = v0 t + 1/2 a t^2)
map.位移变化量与所用时间之比。: The change in displacement divided by the time taken.
map.位移除以时间得平均速度。: Displacement divided by time gives the average velocity.
map.平均是总位移/总时间；瞬时是某时刻速率。变速运动时两者常不同。: Average is total displacement over total time, while instantaneous is the rate at a moment; the two often differ in non-uniform motion.
map.平均速度和平均速率有什么不同？: What is the difference between average velocity and average speed?
map.平均速度用位移（起点到终点的直线距离，含方向），平均速率用路程（实际走过的轨迹长: Average velocity uses displacement (straight line from start to end, with direction) while average speed uses distance travelled (the actual path length). Running one lap of a track back to the start gives zero displacement and so zero average velocity, yet the average speed is not zero; this tool strictly follows the former.
map.平均速度计算器根据位移变化量与所用时间求取平均速度 v̄=Δx/Δt，区分与速率: The average velocity calculator uses the change in displacement and the time taken to compute v = dx/dt, distinguishing it from the concept of speed; it suits introductory kinematics study and experiment data processing.

map.由速度变化与加速度求位移: Displacement from velocity change and acceleration
